SD54-013.name: Garanciere
SD54-013.effect:
This card in Trash is unaffected by any effect.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
Add a "Pilot" family Brave card revealed from deck by your Spirit effects to the Hand.

[LV2] Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
By destroying this Nexus, during this battle, your Life can't be reduced by the opponent. This effect can only be used once per turn.

SD54-014.name: Nahel Argama (UC)
SD54-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Barrage: Cost 5 or less]
This Nexus is unaffected by opposing Cost 5 or less effects.

[LV1][LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
By exhausting this Nexus, destroy every opposing Nexus. This effect can't be prevented by [Barrage]. This effect can only be used once per game.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
By exhausting this Nexus, return an "MS" family Spirit card from the Trash to your Hand.

SD54-016.name: Beam Magnum
SD54-016.effect:
While your "Unicorn Gundam"-named Spirit is battling, treat all of this card's reduction as filled.

[Flash]
Ignoring the "BP+" of Braves, destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit and two 3000 BP or less Spirits. Or, destroy an opposing Nexus and, ignoring the "BP+" of Braves, destroy two opposing 3000 BP or less Spirits.

SD54-010.name: Banagher Links
SD54-010.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[During Brave]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to an opposing effect, by discarding one "MS" family card from your Hand, it remains on the Field, exhausted.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.

SD54-006.name: Delta Plus
SD54-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit and all your "Unicorn Gundam"-named Spirits can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest BP.

SD54-002.name: Geara Zulu
SD54-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a Red "Mothership" family Nexus card and an exactly-named "Kshatriya" among them to the Hand. Return the remaining cards to either only the decktop or only the deckbottom in any order.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
Add an "Unicorn Gundam"-named card revealed by this Spirit's effect to the Hand.

SD54-012.name: Haro
SD54-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Add a Red "MS"/"MA"/"Mothership"/"Support Fighter"/"Pilot"/"Captain"/"Crew" family card among them to your Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
Besides [Soul Core], send up to three cores from your Trash to a Red "MS" family Spirit you control.

SD54-004.name: Jegan
SD54-004.effect:
You can put any amount of copies of this card in your deck.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Summon any number of "Jegan" Spirit cards from your Hand, without paying the cost.

SD54-009.name: Kshatriya
SD54-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step)
Besides [Soul Core], put any amount of cores from your Trash to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
You can send one core from this Spirit to the Trash. When you've done so, destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
You can send three cores from this Spirit to the Trash. When you've done so, either destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit, or an opposing Nexus.

SD54-001.name: Loto
SD54-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Besides this Spirit, if you don't control any exactly-named "Loto", you can summon an exactly-named "Loto" from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, destroy an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit, and draw a card.

SD54-011.name: Marida Cruz
SD54-011.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can put a core from the Trash to this Spirit. When you've done so, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
While this Spirit is Cost 8 or more, it gains an extra Red symbol.

SD54-005.name: ReZEL
SD54-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. Also, while braved to a "Pilot" family Brave, this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing 10000 BP or less Spirits.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.

SD54-003.name: Stark Jegan
SD54-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Red "Mothership" family Nexus card, and an "Unicorn Gundam" to the Hand. Return the remaining cards to only the deckbottom or decktop.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Jegan" Spirit attacks, you can draw a card.

SD54-X02.name: Unicorn Gundam 02 Banshee［Destroy Mode］
SD54-X02.effect:
When this set card is discarded by the opponent, you can activate it, ignoring the Burst condition.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy three opposing Spirits with two cores or less on them.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with five cores or less on it.

SD54-007.name: Unicorn Gundam ［Unicorn Mode］
SD54-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. Among them, add every "Destroy Mode" to the Hand. Return the remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash- [NT-D]
When any player controls a Spirit with at least two symbols, this Spirit can change places with a "Destroy Mode" Spirit card from your Hand in refreshed state. When you do, destroy an opposing Spirit.

SD54-X01.name: Unicorn Gundam［Destroy Mode］
SD54-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy every opposing Spirit with two symbols or more.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit with the highest BP. When this effect destroys, this Spirit refreshes. At the end of battle, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

SD54-015.name: Universal Century Charter
SD54-015.effect:
[Type: Field]
While on the field, all the following effects are active:
█ Neither player can put more than one core on each Grandwalker Nexus per turn.
█ When your [NT-D] activates, you can return this card to your Hand.

[Main]
Draw two cards. Then put this card on your Field.
